note.i: Ius mariti in bona uxoris, & contrà.

page.notes: The first marginal note reads "Ius mariti in bona uxoris, & contrà." (the "i" in "mariti" is printed with a dot-like mark; read as "mariti"). The second reads "Lex in nō baptisatos." The "&" in the body is printed as a full ampersand and is kept. The faint watermark or digitiser mark at the bottom right is excluded. Printed "liber-rimo" and "hæ-" are line-end hyphens, kept as printed.
